_meta.note: Directed influence edges: source shapes what happens in target. strength 0-1 is a judgement of how much decisions in the target are affected. sectors lists who in the target is most exposed ('all' = everyone). Sources can be countries (ISO3) or blocs.

channels.regulation: Rules that apply across borders (data protection, AI, competition, sanctions)
channels.outsourcing: Client demand for services delivered from the target
channels.technology: Platforms, standards and tools set by the source
